oneLineDescription: Iron Halo is a dedicated powerlifting and strongman gym in Salford, Manchester, providing a focused, technically supervised environment for serious lifters.

services.name: Coached programming
services.description: Every member is on a written program from one of our two coaches (IPF cat-2 and BWL level 3).

services.name: Meet prep
services.description: We run cycles into specific competitions, preparing lifters for national events.

services.name: Open floor membership
services.description: Membership for serious independent lifters who want the specialized environment without coaching.

services.name: Strongman block
services.description: Saturday strongman training sessions utilizing the loading bay, weather permitting.

services.name: Nutrition guidance
services.description: Review of food logs upon request, not a full coaching service.

targetAudience: Serious independent lifters, competitive powerlifters, and strongman competitors seeking a focused, technically supervised training environment.
uniqueSellingPoints: No unnecessary machines, televisions, or corporate music.
Extensive specialized equipment including calibrated platforms, competition bars, strongman implements, and 4 tonnes of plates.
Focused, technically supervised environment for heavy lifting.
Mandatory coached programming for all members.
Strict focus on serious lifters, turning away those not aligned with the gym's ethos.
